snippet.title: Upaon Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Help this sympathetic Snake on her journey to the hidden treasure, solve puzzles that mix mechanics of the classic game Snake with Sokoban.

Availlable June 25th here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1660040/Upaon_A_Snakes_Journey/
